relationships.evidence_quote: PTX injection also enhanced NLRP3 (p < 0.001, one-way ANOVA vs. VEH-VEH-VEH treated subjects; Figure 7A)

key_findings: Low-dose CoPP (HO-1 inducer) plus hydrogen-rich water reversed paclitaxel allodynia faster and more fully than either alone and reversed anxiodepressive-like behavior.
The combination normalized PTX-induced NLRP3 and 4-HNE in DRG and amygdala and raised NRF2, HO-1 and SOD-1 while lowering BACH1 in DRG.
